description: Status, counts and one page of per-domain results for a bulk check started by this caller. Results are compact summaries (score, grade, providers, policies, technologies). For email checks spfPolicy and dmarcPolicy can also be missing (no record) or unknown (the lookup failed, an SPF redirect= target's lookup failed, or a subdomain's own _dmarc lookup failed), dmarcPolicy invalid (a record without a valid policy), and mxProvider unknown (the MX lookup failed) or 'null MX (no mail)'. Free.

jobId.description: Job id returned by start_bulk_check (job_ followed by 24 hex characters).

offset.description: Index of the first result to return.

status.description: Only return items in this state, e.g. failed.

name: get_bulk_check

creditsCharged.description: Prepaid credits this call itself charged: 0 for plan keys (they spend daily quota instead) and 0 for start_bulk_check, whose up-front charge is reported in job.creditsCharged and job.quotaUnitsCharged; creditsRemaining already reflects it.
Prepaid credits charged up front; failed and cancelled items are refunded when the job finishes.

result.description: Compact per-domain summary; use the single-domain tool for the full report. For email checks spfPolicy and dmarcPolicy can also be missing (no record) or unknown (the lookup failed, an SPF redirect= target's lookup failed, or a subdomain's own _dmarc lookup failed), dmarcPolicy invalid (a record without a valid policy), and mxProvider unknown (the MX lookup failed) or 'null MX (no mail)'.

nextOffset.description: Pass as offset to fetch the next page; null when this is the last page.

quotaUnitsCharged.description: Daily-quota units charged up front for plan keys; refunded like credits.

title: Get Bulk Check Status and Results
